summary_1line: Demonesses threaten and mock Sita to force her to accept Ravana, but she steadfastly refuses and declares unwavering loyalty to Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, tearful and mud-stained, sits beneath the Shingshapa tree while grotesque demonesses with spears circle her, licking their lips and shouting threats.
Hidden in the branches above, Hanuman crouches silently in the Shingshapa tree as he watches the demonesses menace the grieving Sita below.
A monstrous demoness brandishes a spear and snarls about devouring Sita’s heart while the frightened princess trembles yet refuses to yield.
